comparison.objective: Open an obstructed locker and remove a tipped case upright.
comparison.physical_skill: Door manipulation, stabilization, bimanual extraction, and upright placement.
comparison.success_condition: Case ends upright on the mat without excessive tipping, dropping, or unsafe door motion.
comparison.reason: The record tests recovery and transport of an unstable case, not handed mechanical installation, telescoping alignment, spring retention, or screw fastening.
